$comment: Visit Moganshan news source registry. Consumed by editorial/scripts/sweep.mjs and validated by editorial/scripts/news-lib.mjs (validateRegistry). Tiers per editorial/sources/source-tiers.md. articlePattern is a JS regex matched against absolute hrefs found on the listing pages; it is deliberately URL shaped rather than DOM selector shaped because the URL patterns were verified and the DOM was not. Listing level `filter` controls title matching: none keeps everything, core requires a keywords.core match, all allows core, villages or topics. keywords.excludeNoise is always removed. renderedClientSide and manualOnly listings are skipped by the crawler and listed in the manual check section of the triage file. isSearch means the listing URL is itself a keyword query, so no title filter is applied. A listing with format rss is read as an RSS 2.0 feed: items are dated by the feed, the publisher named by the feed is carried as `via`, and articlePattern is optional. The two search feeds (Google News, Bing News) are aggregators: they find the item, the publisher they name decides the tier, and the article is read at the publisher before a word is drafted. Keywords are matched case insensitively, so English terms in core catch English headlines.

sources.cadence: 4 to 6 tourism items per week, daily in news channels
sources.publishes: County tourism, events, tea season, races, openings, local policy
sources.authority: Reliable for what is happening. County media convergence centre, so it reports a new hotel enthusiastically and will not report a failed one.
sources.notes: Carries roughly 70 percent of any given week. Newsroom 0572-8661890, dqnews@163.com.

sources.robots: HanWeb CMS, listing pages scrapable, no feed
sources.cadence: several items per day across columns
sources.publishes: Ticket price adjustments, scenic area closures, resort planning, event launches, tenders
sources.authority: HIGHEST. Price changes and closures are legally required to be published here. Nothing overrides it.
sources.notes: Bureau namespace is /hzgov/front/sNNN/. s203 = culture, broadcasting, tourism and sports bureau. s232 = Moganshan Town. Watch col1229212604 in early February for the 新春第一会 ten openings document.

sources.nameZh: 湖州市文化广电旅游局
sources.nameEn: Huzhou Municipal Bureau of Culture, Radio, TV and Tourism
sources.publishes: Municipal tourism statistics, holiday visitor numbers, resort industry conferences, market inspections
sources.authority: HIGH for visitor statistics and holiday data. The only acceptable source for visitor numbers alongside the provincial department.

sources.nameZh: 浙江省文化广电和旅游厅
sources.nameEn: Zhejiang Provincial Department of Culture, Radio, TV and Tourism
sources.publishes: Province wide policy, A level scenic area rating changes, resort designations, subsidy programmes
sources.authority: HIGHEST for A level and resort status changes and province wide rules. Moganshan is a national level resort, so designation news lands here.

sources.nameZh: 莫干山国际旅游度假区
sources.publishes: Official ticketing and scenic area announcements, presumed
sources.notes: Returns 403 from outside China. Booking page, ticket tariff and any official WeChat mini programme could not be read. MANUAL CHECK REQUIRED from inside China before relying on it. Ticketing enquiries 0572-8412345 (verified against two independent sources).

sources.nameZh: 中国旅游报 / 中国旅游新闻网
sources.publisher: 中国旅游报社有限公司, a directly affiliated unit of the Ministry of Culture and Tourism
sources.publishes: National policy of record: visa rules, A level ratings, industry regulation
sources.authority: HIGHEST for national policy. Rarely covers Moganshan directly, use for the policy backdrop.

sources.nameZh: Google 新闻 搜索订阅
sources.cadence: 100 items per feed, newest first, usually a few per day for 莫干山
sources.publishes: Everything Google indexes as news: Sina, NetEase, Sohu, Tencent and Toutiao republications of 德清发布 and 湖州发布, the provincial papers, The Paper, trade press
sources.authority: AGGREGATOR. Google has no tier. The publisher named in the item (via) decides the tier: a 新浪 republication of a 德清发布 post is tier 4, a 潮新闻 piece is tier 2, a 澎湃 piece is tier 2.
sources.notes: Verified 7 September 2026: 100 items, dated, reachable from this machine without browser headers. Links are Google redirects (news.google.com/rss/articles/...); WebFetch follows them to the publisher. The ledger keys on the redirect, so the same story found on a direct listing is caught by the title hash, not the URL. Noise to expect: 莫干山板材 (a plywood brand), 莫干山康溪 (a badminton club), 莫干山路 in Shanghai; all in excludeNoise.

sources.nameZh: Google 新闻 英文搜索订阅
sources.publishes: Xinhua English, China Daily, CGTN, Global Times, SHINE, press release wires (GlobeNewswire, PR Newswire), SmartShanghai, ArchDaily, hotel trade press
sources.authority: AGGREGATOR, same rule as the Chinese feed: the publisher decides the tier. A press release wire is tier 4 and a brand claim; Xinhua English and China Daily are tier 2.
sources.notes: Verified 7 September 2026: 45 items, most of them older than the lookback, so a typical sweep keeps one or two. The English search is also how the site learns what the English speaking press is saying about Moganshan, which matters for corrections (the Lonely Planet Moganshan Lodge problem).

sources.nameZh: 必应新闻 搜索订阅
sources.publishes: A second, smaller index of the same Chinese portals (Sohu, Sina, NetEase), sometimes a day ahead of Google
sources.authority: AGGREGATOR. The publisher decides the tier.
sources.notes: Verified 7 September 2026: 11 Chinese items and 2 English, dated. Bing's links are click trackers with the publisher's URL in the query string; the parser unwraps them, so a Bing item and the same article on a direct listing share a ledger key.

sources.publishes: Province wide features, county rural revitalisation, the Moganshan conference, the sports plus art framing (18 February 2026 piece on the resort)
sources.authority: HIGH for the framing, county supplied for the detail. Same caveat as Xinhua: check the byline.
sources.notes: Verified 7 September 2026: 111 links on the channel front, dated as /n2/YYYY/MMDD/. Reachable from this machine.

sources.nameEn: Hangzhou CPPCC news portal, city affairs
sources.publishes: Republishes the Hangzhou dailies on infrastructure: it carried every 杭德市域铁路 milestone (December 2023, April 2025, January 2026, April 2026)
sources.authority: MEDIUM to HIGH. A government portal republishing Hangzhou Daily and Metropolis Express; the byline names the paper.
sources.notes: Verified 7 September 2026: 38 dated links, same CMS as hangzhou.com.cn. The most reliable open web trail for the rail line, which is the standing watch item with the largest consequence.

sources.nameZh: 湖州市人民政府 / 湖州市交通运输局
sources.nameEn: Huzhou Municipal People's Government and its transport bureau
sources.publishes: Municipal framing of the resort (28 March 2025 planning piece), Moganshan night economy (12 September 2024), bus and road notices at the prefecture level
sources.authority: HIGH. Municipal government of record above Deqing. The transport bureau is the publisher for prefecture level bus changes.
sources.notes: HanWeb CMS like deqing.gov.cn. Times out from outside China, so it lands in the manual check list most days; the Google News feed catches its republications.

sources.publishes: Every Moganshan race with its date, distances and registration window: UTMB (April), MONTANE VIA (April), Kailas skyrace (October), Spartan (November), the legend first trail race
sources.authority: REGISTRATION PLATFORM. Reliable for the date and whether registration is open, because the platform sells the places. Not a source for anything else.
sources.notes: Verified 7 September 2026: 104 event links on the trail page, titles carry 莫干山 when relevant, no date in the URL so items stay undated until the page is read. An event page is one URL for the life of the race, so the ledger sees each race once; re read when a fixture window opens.

sources.nameZh: 朗途体育 赛事官网
sources.nameEn: Letour Sports organiser site (Kailas Moganshan Skyrace)
sources.publishes: The Kailas Moganshan Skyrace regulations, course changes, road closures on race weekend
sources.authority: ORGANISER. Authoritative for its own race, promotional for everything else.
sources.notes: Verified 7 September 2026: 34 links, the 2026 race page present. The site hosts the organiser's other races too, so the core filter matters.

sources.nameZh: 莫干山越野赛 by UTMB 官网
sources.publishes: Race dates, registration opening, course, the official accommodation list
sources.authority: ORGANISER. Authoritative for the April race.
sources.notes: Verified 7 September 2026: the news page is client rendered (448 KB, no server side article links), so it is a manual check. The accommodation page is a useful list of which hotels the organiser partners with.

sources.nameZh: 浙江省人民政府 英文网
sources.nameEn: eZhejiang, the provincial government's English portal
sources.publishes: English language provincial news: rural tourism designations, Huzhou features, the Mogan Mountain entry of 3 June 2020
sources.authority: OFFICIAL, in English. Good for the English name of a policy or a designation; thin on dates.
sources.notes: Verified 7 September 2026: 78 links, dated as /YYYY-MM/DD/. Run by China Daily for the provincial government, so the same copy appears on regional.chinadaily.com.cn.

sources.nameZh: 中国日报 湖州频道
sources.publishes: English profiles of the resort (6 September 2024), the high tech zone, Huzhou tourism announcements in English
sources.authority: MEDIUM. Sponsored regional channel, copy supplied by the Huzhou government. The English name of a place or a scheme is the useful part.
sources.notes: Verified 7 September 2026: reachable over http, 69 links; the first https attempt timed out, so expect the odd timeout in the triage file. Only the http URL is registered.

sources.publishes: Shanghai expat view of Moganshan: festival tickets, new venues, weekend guides, the Discovery park and naked Castle listings
sources.authority: LIFESTYLE. Reliable for what Shanghai's English speaking market is being sold this month; not a source for a price or an official date.
sources.notes: Verified 7 September 2026: 48 links, article URLs undated. The core filter needs the English keywords, which are in keywords.core. Time Out Shanghai and That's Shanghai were checked the same day: Time Out's site is a shell of old features, That's is unreachable from here; both are covered by the English Google News feed instead.

sources.publishes: New hotel round ups (Dusit Thani Mogan Mountain, 5 October 2023), brand signings, Chinese outbound and domestic trade news
sources.authority: TRADE. Same rule as Meadin: never publish an opening off this alone.
sources.notes: Verified 7 September 2026: 10 items in the feed, dated. Hospitality Net returns 403 to any non browser client and Travel Daily Media 403 as well; both are in the manual hotel trade list.

sources.cadence: monthly, and when a brand signing appears in Meadin
sources.publishes: Four Seasons Moganshan announcement (Hospitality Net, September 2025), brand press releases in English
sources.authority: TRADE, press release driven. English wording of a brand announcement, nothing more.
sources.notes: All four return 403 or an empty page to a script. Open in a browser when Meadin or the Google feed reports a signing.

listings.label: 莫干山旅游 公众号

sources.cadence: weekly, and 7 to 10 days before each holiday
sources.publishes: The only open web way into WeChat official accounts: 德清发布, 爱德清, 莫干山旅游, 德清交警. Holiday programmes, road restrictions, ticket notices.
sources.authority: PROMOTIONAL, as for aideqing. The account is the publisher; Sogou is the index.
sources.notes: Verified 7 September 2026: the page answers with 8 to 10 article links behind Sogou redirects and no dates on the listing, and the index is stale for days at a time (tsn=1 asks for the last day). A script gets a captcha after a few requests, so it stays manual. When the reviewer opens an article, the WeChat page carries the account name and the date; cite those, not Sogou.

sources.nameZh: 德清108社区 畅说德清
sources.cadence: before each holiday and on a weather warning
sources.publishes: Reposts of 德清发布 traffic control notices within hours, tunnel closures, the Golden Week Moganshan traffic plan (National Day 2024)
sources.authority: FORUM. A tip, never a source. The notice it reposts names the publisher (usually 德清县公安局交通警察大队); find and cite that.
sources.notes: Verified 7 September 2026: 66 links, mostly job adverts and classifieds, so a crawl would drown the triage file. Search the forum for 交通管制 or 莫干山 by hand.

sources.nameZh: 中国天气网 莫干山镇
sources.publishes: Typhoon, heavy rain, snow and ice warnings
sources.authority: The leading indicator for mountain road closures. A Moganshan road closure is nearly always weather driven.
sources.notes: Station code 101210204004 is Moganshan Town. 101210204 is Deqing county seat. The mountain runs several degrees cooler, which is the whole marketing premise, so always use the town code.

sources.nameZh: 浙江在线 湖州频道

listings.label: 90早新闻
listings.note: Daily province wide briefing of openings, ticket offers, festivals and registrations. Verified 7 September 2026: 39 dated links, the Moganshan music festival announcement ran here on 29 July 2026.

sources.publishes: Regional framing, provincial state outlet
sources.authority: HIGH

sources.publishes: Provincial features on Deqing, summer season launches, conference coverage
sources.authority: MEDIUM. Much Deqing content is contributed by 爱德清 and local propaganda departments and republished verbatim. Check the byline. Treat republished items at county trust level, not provincial.
sources.notes: No date in the URL. The sweep script cannot date these automatically, so they land in the manual triage bucket. Verified client rendered: the homepage returns 1.8MB with zero server side article links. Manual check only.

listings.label: 杭州网 浙江新闻
listings.note: Verified 7 September 2026: 48 dated links, reachable without browser headers. Carried the Moganshan cool economy piece on 29 July 2026.

listings.label: 杭州网 原创
listings.note: Verified 7 September 2026: 81 dated links. Ran the rail track completion on 19 May 2026.

sources.publishes: Moganshan as a Hangzhou weekend destination
sources.authority: MEDIUM to HIGH
sources.notes: Hangzhou is Moganshan's number one origin market, so the angle is exactly the one an English travel site needs. The mid January race calendar release has run here. Returns HTTP 503 to a non browser user agent. requiresBrowserHeaders is set.

sources.nameZh: 新华网 德清、地方、长三角、英文
sources.nameEn: Xinhua: Deqing topic, local, Yangtze delta and English channels

listings.label: 新华网 地方
listings.note: Verified 7 September 2026: 34 dated links. The rail track completion ran here on 18 May 2026.

listings.label: 新华网 长三角
listings.note: Verified 7 September 2026: 20 dated links, Huzhou items weekly.

listings.label: Xinhua English
listings.note: Verified 7 September 2026: 90 links. English wire items on Deqing and the Moganshan conference.

sources.$note: The pattern also matches csj.news.cn and english.news.cn, which share the /YYYYMMDD/hash/c.html shape.
sources.publishes: National wire coverage of Deqing, conferences, rural revitalisation
sources.authority: HIGH, with the same county supplied copy caveat
sources.notes: AVOID zj.xinhuanet.com, it has a TLS certificate hostname mismatch and automated fetchers fail cert validation. Use www.news.cn paths only. The deqingzt topic page is stale, newest links seen are 2022. The local, Yangtze delta and English channels added 7 September 2026 are live and dated; the Google News feed covers the rest of news.cn.

sources.nameZh: 澎湃新闻 澎湃浙江
sources.publishes: Overtourism, homestay oversupply, occupancy collapse, sceptical reporting
sources.authority: HIGH. The most likely Chinese source to publish something negative or sceptical about Moganshan. Valuable counterweight to promotional sources.
sources.notes: www.thepaper.cn returns 403 to non browser clients. Use m.thepaper.cn with a browser user agent. Low frequency, worth a manual search rather than a listing crawl. m.thepaper.cn returned 403 even with browser headers in testing. Treat as a manual weekly search for 莫干山.

sources.nameZh: 南太湖号 / 湖州日报
sources.notes: Huzhou Media Group convergence app with no good open web mirror. Do not chase it. Use zjol-huzhou and huzhou-cts for Huzhou level news instead.

listings.label: 莫干山搜索
listings.note: Search results are client rendered. Server HTML is an 8KB shell with zero article links. Check by hand, or crawl sitemap_index.xml instead.

sources.publishes: Hotel openings, signings, brand launches, M and A, occupancy and RevPAR data
sources.authority: TRADE. Runs brand supplied press releases near verbatim. Announced opening dates slip constantly.
sources.notes: The cleanest scraping target in the registry. Sister properties: 迈点研究院 res.meadin.com, 迈点指数 i.meadin.com. NEVER publish an opening off this alone. Confirm trading on Dianping or Ctrip first.

sources.publishes: OTA, distribution, travel tech, investment
sources.authority: TRADE
sources.notes: Less useful for a single resort opening than Meadin, more useful for Ctrip, Meituan and Fliggy strategy that changes how Moganshan gets sold.

sources.publishes: Long form analysis of hotel asset deals, brand strategy, why a resort failed
sources.authority: OPINION, NOT RECORD. Never cite for a number.
sources.notes: Verified client rendered. Monitor via the syndication mirrors instead: jiemian.com, 36kr.com, tmtpost.com, news.qq.com.

CORRECTION TO ANY WATCH LIST: premium Moganshan inventory is naked Retreats, 郡安里, 开元森泊, 法国山居, 大乐之野, 西坡 and hundreds of independents. Aman, Banyan Tree and IHG have NO verified Moganshan property. A watch list built on those three returns nothing.

sources.nameEn: Deqing county media convergence WeChat accounts
sources.publishes: Holiday programmes 7 to 10 days before each Golden Week and Spring Festival, road restriction notices, event announcements
sources.authority: PROMOTIONAL. Event dates are usually right. Visitor numbers, superlatives and first in China claims are not.
sources.notes: WeChat official accounts are not addressable by URL. This is the operative publisher for road restrictions, usually via 德清县公安局交通警察大队, not the transport bureau.

sources.authority: NEVER CITE FOR AN OFFICIAL PRICE.
sources.notes: Worst offenders for stale prices. One page was still headlined 2025莫干山门票 while carrying text written 18 July 2022 quoting 68 RMB.

Deqing sits under the Huzhou city node. Filter by 新店, sort by 最新开业. BEST SINGLE CONFIRMATION that a venue is actually trading, which is step two of the hotel opening chain. Aggressive anti scraping, treat as manual.
Filter hotel search by 新开业 to confirm rooms are actually bookable. Also the affiliate partner, so treat commercial pages with care in editorial.
Sort by 最新 for new venues, 最热 for trends. Login walled and heavily bot protected. TREND SIGNAL ONLY, never a source for prices or dates.
Hashtag view counts week over week. A new POI or 团购 listing in 抖音生活服务 is a reliable opening signal. Hard blocked to bots, manual only.
热门游记 and 攻略. Slower moving, better for itinerary shifts than for news.
Price cross check only. Never the authoritative tariff.

keywords.$noiseNote: The second line is the English noise. The third is the Sina content farm: in the first week of September 2026 the Chinese Google feed carried 35 machine written guide pieces titled 莫干山...攻略/怎么选/怎么玩+FAQ against 10 news items, all from 新浪旅游 and 新浪财经. None is news; every one carries at least one of these terms. Deqing News guide pieces with 攻略 in the title are dropped too, and that is intended: a guide is not an item.
